remarks: Welcome to this beautifully renovated and spacious 2,500 sq ft home offering flexibility, style, and income or multi-generational living potential! The main residence features 3 bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms, with a smart layout that includes one bedroom and full bath on the first floor and two additional bedrooms upstairs. Step inside through the covered front porch/mudroom into a bright and updated interior, where the kitchen—with convenient first-floor laundry—features a large pass-through opening to the formal dining room, creating great flow for everyday living and entertaining, which continues into the living room with a stunning two-story ceiling above the fireplace. Every inch of this home has been thoughtfully updated and freshly painted, creating a clean, modern feel throughout. The property is heated with electric wall units, offering simple and efficient zone-style heating. Off the back of the home, you’ll find a small deck perfect for relaxing or entertaining, along with exterior access leading to a private in-law suite. This separate living space includes its own entrance, a full kitchen, living room, bedroom, bathroom, and dedicated laundry—ideal for extended family, guests, or potential rental income. The upper unit also boasts a large two-story deck overlooking the backyard, offering additional outdoor living space. With its versatile layout, updated condition, and multiple living options, this property is a rare find that combines comfort, functionality, and opportunity all in one.
